title: Implement Legacy We Have A Plan

cards.title: We Have A Plan / They Will Be Lost And Confused (V)
issues: Back: 'Flip this card (and if possible, relocate Palpatine to a prison and imprison him there) if Palpatine is about to be captured, lost, missing, or removed from table' is not implemented at all. The OVS 1116_011_BACK on master at least flips on isAboutToBeLost(Palpatine).
Tests use provisional OVS Prison/Decipher Palpatine; canonical Block 5 versions noted as pending by the worker.

review.blocked_on: Relocate-and-imprison part may need an engine replacement hook (swccg-guild/work#182)
review.fix_instructions: Add a required trigger on the back for Palpatine about to be captured/lost/missing/removed from table that flips the card (OVS 1116_011_BACK pattern, extended to the other about-to events), and relocate/imprison him at a prison where possible; if relocation truly needs an engine hook, implement the flip now and mark relocation BLOCKED. Add tests.
review.notes: Front fully implemented and tested (Coruscant + Prison with imprisoned Palpatine, optional Security Control, no conversion, +1 generation, clone Monnok immunity, no transfer at Flagship sites, site download, flip). Back's other clauses tested. #657 depends on this PR.

pc_front.gametext: We Have A Plan: Deploy Coruscant system (may not be converted) and Blockade Flagship: Prison with Palpatine imprisoned there. May deploy Security Control. {For} remainder of game, your Force generation is +1 at Coruscant battlegrounds. Unless you have 13 or more cards in hand, clones are immune to Monnok. {While} this side up, at Blockade Flagship sites, imprisoned captives may not be transferred. Once per turn, may deploy a battleground site to Coruscant from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. {Flip} this card if Palpatine on Coruscant. They Will Be Lost And Confused: {Immediately} take any one card into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. {While} this side up, whenever a card of ability > 2 is lost, its owner loses 1 Force. While you control two battlegrounds with clones, opponent must have two cards with ability (or two [Presence] droids) to initiate a Force drain. Once per turn, may deploy a clone from Lost Pile. Clones are immune to attrition < 4. {Flip} this card (and if possible, relocate Palpatine to a prison and imprison him there) if Palpatine is about to be captured, lost, missing, or removed from table.
pc_front.title: We Have A Plan / They Will Be Lost And Confused (V)

cards.title: Clone Trooper
issues: Objective-dependent clauses (Palpatine immune to attrition < 6, your drains +1 at same site while [VB5] They Will Be Lost And Confused on table) have only a negative test; positive test needs 1250_78 (PR #693).

review.blocked_on: PR #693 (We Have A Plan / They Will Be Lost And Confused 1250_78)
review.notes: Code is complete and matches printed text (Heroic with Palpatine, +1 power/forfeit on Coruscant, objective-conditioned modifiers using Icon.LEGACY_BLOCK_5 + title, compatible with #693's back). Can merge in the same batch as #693; add a positive objective test.

pc_front.gametext: While with Palpatine, Heroic. Power and forfeit +1 on Coruscant. While [Virtual Block 5] They Will Be Lost And Confused on table, Palpatine is immune to attrition < 6 and your Force drains at same site are +1.

title: Implement Legacy Coruscant Council and Landing Platform

cards.title: Coruscant: Jedi Council Chamber (V)
issues: Dark side: Wipe suspension condition is evaluated once inside getGameTextDarkSideWhileActiveModifiers (modifiers are built once in PhysicalCardImpl.startAffectingGame), so it is frozen at the moment the site enters play.
No positive test of the Wipe suspension (needs #587).

cards.title: Coruscant: Senate Landing Platform
issues: Dark side 'Unless you occupy, [VB5] Wipe Them Out, All Of Them ignores starship and holosite sites' is not implemented; needs support in Wipe (PR #587 or a follow-up).

review.shared_changes: GameTextActionId: appended two search ids. Safe.
review.blocked_on: PR #587 (Block 5 Wipe Them Out) for 1250_74 dark text and positive tests
review.fix_instructions: 1250_72: always return the SuspendsCardModifier and pass the logic as a Condition (SuspendsCardModifier(source, filter, condition)): condition = !controls(darkPlayer, battleground_site) OR canSpot(your non-battleground site with no related locations), evaluated live. Add a test that toggles the condition after the site is on table. 1250_74: implement the dark-side clause once #587 lands (Wipe must ignore starship/holosite sites unless the Platform's dark-side player occupies), with tests.
review.notes: Light-side text of both sites is correct and tested (Senate restriction, Used Pile take on Council member deploy; starships deploy here, once-per-turn starship site download).

pc_front.gametext: Light: May not be deployed if your Senate on table. If you just deployed a Jedi Council Member here, may take any one card into hand from Used Pile; reshuffle. Dark: If your non-battleground site on table with no related locations (or if you do not control a battleground site), [Virtual Block 5] Wipe Them Out, All Of Them is suspended.
pc_front.title: •Coruscant: Jedi Council Chamber (V)

pc_front.gametext: Light: Starships may deploy here. Once per turn, may deploy a starship site from Reserve Deck if its starship card on table; reshuffle. Dark: Unless you occupy, [Virtual Block 5] Wipe Them Out, All Of Them ignores starship and holosite sites.
pc_front.title: •Coruscant: Senate Landing Platform

cards.title: Changing The Odds (V)
issues: Second mode 'If both players just drew one battle destiny, cancel and redraw both destiny draws' is not implemented. The OVS 1112_003 on master has the identical text and already implements it (isBattleDestinyDrawingJustCompletedForBothPlayers + didBothPlayersDrawOneBattleDestiny, CancelPreviousBattleDestinyDrawsEffect x2, DrawDestinyEffect x2).

review.fix_instructions: Port mode 2 from Card1112_003 (same text) and add a gameplay test (both players draw one battle destiny -> both canceled and redrawn; not offered when a player drew 2). If the worker believes the OVS accounting is wrong, show it with a failing test instead of omitting the mode.
review.notes: Mode 1 is correct and well tested (weapon/Interrupt/Objective/Epic Event, drawer activates and shuffles, decline path, last-card case).

pc_front.gametext: If a player is about to draw destiny for an Epic Event, Interrupt, Objective, or weapon, that player must first activate 1 Force and shuffle their Reserve Deck. OR If both players just drew one battle destiny, cancel and redraw both destiny draws.
pc_front.lore: Qui-Gon used his Jedi abilities to insure that there was no 'chance' involved with the use of Watto's chance cube.
pc_front.title: •Changing The Odds (V)
